output.question: For Lagos, Cairo, and Kinshasa, find current populations and growth rates and tell me which is growing fastest.

sources.title: Lagos, Nigeria Metro Area Population (1950-2026) | MacroTrends
Kinshasa, Republic of Congo Metro Area Population (1950-2026) | MacroTrends

output.findings:
As of 2025/2026 estimates, the populations for the three cities are: Cairo (approximately 23.1 million), Kinshasa (approximately 17.8 million to 18.6 million), and Lagos (approximately 17.2 million to 17.8 million). 

Regarding growth rates, data indicates that Kinshasa is experiencing the fastest growth among the three, with an annual growth rate estimated at 4.36% for 2026. Lagos follows with an annual growth rate estimated at 3.78% for the same period. While a precise current annual growth rate for Cairo was not explicitly captured in the provided text, it is generally understood to have a lower growth rate compared to the rapid expansion seen in sub-Saharan megacities like Kinshasa and Lagos.

distiller or formatter does that. If the question cannot be answered
